description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:

In 2026, we built Alpaca’s communications function from the ground up. In a single quarter we tripled our media coverage, and our leaders now speak on some of the industry’s largest stages. Our Communications team shapes how the world understands the infrastructure behind modern investing, from tokenized stocks and 24/5 trading to AI-native brokerage.

We’re looking for a Senior Communications Manager to help us scale. Reporting to the VP of Communications, you’ll partner on Alpaca’s biggest moments and own the programs that carry our story to more voices, launches and markets. This is a builder role for a hands-on operator with strong judgment in a regulated, global business, a bias for proactive storytelling, and the drive to build an AI-first communications operation that gives a small team outsized reach.

What you’ll do

  • Build our spokesperson bench. Develop subject-matter experts beyond the CEO, with positioning, talk tracks, briefing materials and media training.
  • Run a global speaking and awards program, from scouting and pitching to speaker prep and on-site support.
  • Own media relations for designated spokespeople and business areas. Build relationships with reporters across fintech, capital markets, digital assets and AI, and grow our presence on podcasts, broadcast and independent media.
  • Lead launch communications for priority product, partnership, regulatory and market announcements, coordinating messaging, timelines and approvals across Product, Marketing, Legal and Compliance, with storylines that outlast the news cycle.
  • Drive regional communications with local leaders in priority markets, adapting Alpaca’s global narrative for each and building repeatable playbooks for launches and market entries.
  • Build Alpaca’s engineering brand, showcasing our engineers, technical work and open-source contributions through engineering blogs, tech talks, developer communities and tech media, in partnership with Engineering and Content & Media.
  • Support internal communications, partnering with People and leadership on company announcements, leadership updates and all-hands so every team hears important news clearly and consistently.
  • Build an AI-first comms operation for monitoring, briefings, tracking and reporting, and own the integrated communications calendar.
  • Partner with the VP on major announcements and incidents, and manage day-to-day work with our agency.

In your first six months, you’ll:

  • Grow our active spokesperson bench beyond the CEO with positioning and media training
  • Build a pipeline of top-tier speaking opportunities and award submissions
  • Own communications for priority launches and two to three international markets
  • Stand up AI-enabled monitoring, briefing and reporting workflows

What we’re looking for:

  • 7–10 years in communications, ideally in-house at a fintech, brokerage, capital markets or digital assets company
  • Established relationships with financial, fintech and crypto media, plus a feel for podcasts, livestreams and social-first channels
  • Proven experience building speaking and spokesperson programs and coaching executives for interviews and stages
  • Exceptional writer and storyteller with a track record of proactive campaigns
  • Sound judgment in a regulated environment and comfort working closely with Legal and Compliance
  • Experience running communications across regions and time zones
  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily and have automated communications workflows without sacrificing accuracy
  • Thrives in a remote, fast-moving environment and aligns senior stakeholders with clear communication

Nice to have:

  • Experience developing communications initiatives in global markets including Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East or Latin America
  • Deep understanding of traditional markets, tokenization, digital assets, emerging asset classes, and market structure
  • Background in developer-focused or B2B infrastructure companies

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
